DEVOUT-DEVOUT.title: The Devout
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.description: A horned elfin warrior, wielding a divine blade. Deeply pious, she inflicts endless penance for her failure, and her nature.
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.eventDeathPrevention: [sine][gold]I shall not be cowed! Only The Mother may deign to take my soul![/gold][/sine]
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.aromaPrinciple: Rend my flesh, scald my spirit. This penance is naught.
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.goldMonologue: [sine]Coinage[/sine]? [sine]Tribute[/sine]? Naught but a triviality under the heat of [sine]The Father's[/sine] blazing gaze.
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.cardsModifierDescription: Devout cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
